A tool to help you write an effective script to help you get an objective from someone.

User-entered data stays in your browser and is not uploaded by this tool.  
The information you enter is never saved by us on our servers.

[Learn DEAR + MAN before building a script](/learn/interpersonal-effectiveness/dear-man.html)

::: {.callout-tip title="Which DEAR skill fits?"}
- **Objective priority:** DEAR MAN — focus on obtaining a concrete result.
- **Relationship priority:** [DEAR GIVE](/tool-finder/dear-give/) — focus on the relationship while making the request.
- **Self-respect priority:** [DEAR FAST](/tool-finder/dear-fast/) — focus on your values and self-respect while making the request.
:::
